subject: MPX listing: integration milestones & entitlement mapping for BrightAnalytics
messages:

Subject: Re: MPX listing inquiry - integration kickoff

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. AWS asked us to reach out to Redwood directly to start the metering/fulfillment integration and confirm co-sell readiness for BrightAnalytics' SaaS listing. We have a tight timeline: target publishing window is the week of Nov 22 so our GTM team can coordinate co-sell motions in December.

Quick background: we are a data analytics SaaS (BrightAnalytics). We will be using usage-based metering (RUUs per API call + seat licensing for enterprise bundles). Our procurement team expects a clear mapping of SKUs -> entitlement keys, webhook examples for usage events, and the fulfillment SOW for marketplace activation.

Attached: MPX_Integration_Specs.pdf (high-level architecture), Entitlement_Mapping_CSV.csv (internal draft).

High-level asks:
- What are Redwood's requirements for the entitlement token format?
- Do you support both Marketplace metering and direct invoice (reserved capacity) routing?
- Proposed mutual action plan & gating items to hit Nov 22 publishing.

Can you propose a short M-A-P and a kickoff time?}

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Partnerships
BrightAnalytics Inc.

+1 415-555-0198

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPX listing inquiry - integration kickoff

Sofia — thanks for the clear context and the files. Happy to lead the Redwood side. High level answers up-front:
- Redwood supports Marketplace metering via webhooks + signed entitlement tokens. We can also route larger enterprise customers to Reserved (Dedicated) through a routing policy after the listing is live.
- We need SKU<->entitlement mapping final by Nov 10 to generate test entitlements for MPX testing.

Mutual action plan (proposal):
1) This week (by Nov 5): finalize SKU and entitlement mapping CSV (your side) -> Redwood will validate formats and return a signed example token.
2) Nov 6–12: Redwood engineering to provide webhook samples, MPX API payloads, and a sandbox webhook endpoint. (see MPX_API_Samples.json — I asked Aditya to attach.)
3) Nov 13–17: Legal & procurement exchange SOW andDocs; Redwood to provide SOW template and pricing SKU notes.
4) Nov 18–21: Internal canary publish to MPX sandbox; AWS enablement review.
5) Nov 22: Production listing publish window.

Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff Wed Nov 3 at 9am PT? I’ve invited Aditya and Marcus for the engineering bits and Vivek for go-to-market/co-sell ops. I'll attach a concise checklist from Redwood (attaching MPX_Integration_Specs.pdf again) and the MPX_API_Samples.json for the sandbox payloads.

My asks for you now: final SKU mapping (CSV) and confirmation of the primary procurement contact for SOW.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park

kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Office: (650) 555-0123

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, sofia.ramos@brightanalytics.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPX listing: integration milestones & entitlement mapping for BrightAnalytics

Sofia / team — adding the technical checklist and sandbox examples. Key engineering notes:

- Entitlement token: Redwood accepts a JWT with claims: sku_id, customer_id, seats, expiry, signature. We will provide a sample signed token for validation.
- Metering events: prefer batched webhook posting (JSON array) with the following fields per event: timestamp, sku_id, usage_value, customer_id, event_id. See MPX_API_Samples.json for concrete examples.
- Webhook signing: Redwood expects an HMAC-SHA256 signature header (X-Redwood-Signature) and a shared secret; we will provide a sandbox secret.
- Consumption model edge cases: zero-dollar trials, proration for mid-cycle seat changes — please note them in the CSV so we can flag billing behavior.

Sandbox timeline commitment: we can provision a sandbox webhook & test tokens by Nov 9 if we have the final CSV by Nov 5. Engineer on-call for integration: aditya_rao (that's me) and marcus_lin.

Attachment: MPX_API_Samples.json

On Wed Nov 3 09:00 PT — I’ll share a short runbook and post-integration smoke tests (token validation, signature verification, event replay).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: sofia.ramos@brightanalytics.com, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOW and procurement checklist for MPX listing

Sofia — looping in Legal/Finance items we need to move the SOW and activation: 

1) Pricing table & SKU definitions (final CSV) — required for the SOW exhibit.
2) Data processing/retention: confirm if customer usage payloads include PII; if so, we need the data handling appendix.
3) Billing reconciliation cadence: monthly by default; please confirm if BrightAnalytics requires daily usage reports for invoices.
4) Commercial terms: typical Redwood MPX SOW uses 30-day payment on net invoices; if you need different terms we’ll surface to finance.

I attached a draft SOW with placeholders (SOW_Draft_BrightAnalytics.docx). Can you confirm procurement contact and whether BrightAnalytics has a standard Master Services Agreement we prefer to use?

If possible, please sign off on the pricing exhibit by Nov 10 so we can include it in the vendor enablement package for AWS review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
